issues.legal_issue: A civil court cannot grant relief concerning agricultural land where the claimant’s entitlement depends on landholding rights that remain to be determined exclusively by a revenue court.
material_facts: The dispute concerned agricultural land, and the claimant’s asserted share and landholding rights had not been determined by a revenue court.
The claimant had filed a revenue-court suit seeking determination of those rights.

The civil suit sought to invalidate a gift deed to the extent of the claimed share and to restrain dealings with the land; granting that relief required first determining the claimant’s landholding rights.
issues.conclusion: The civil suit was barred while the claimant’s landholding rights remained pending before the revenue court. The High Court’s decision was upheld and the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Section 9 of the Code of Civil Procedure gives civil courts jurisdiction over civil suits unless jurisdiction is expressly or impliedly barred. Under Sections 207 and 256 of the Rajasthan Tenancy Act, read with Section 88 and item 5 of the Third Schedule, a revenue court has exclusive jurisdiction over a suit to declare the specified landholding rights, and the civil-court bar also applies where the cause of action is one for which relief could be obtained in the revenue court, even if the civil suit seeks different or additional relief. Under Order VII Rule 11(d) of the Code, a plaint is rejected when the suit appears from its statements to be barred by law. Bank of Baroda v Moti Bhai (1985) 1 SCC 475 requires attention to the substance of the matter rather than the form of the suit. Shri Ram v A.D.J. (2001) 3 SCC 24 distinguishes a recorded tenure-holder whose title is not under cloud from a claimant who first needs a revenue-court declaration; the latter must obtain that declaration before seeking civil relief that depends on it.

rule.if: civil_suit and agricultural_land_dispute and claimant_landholding_rights_unadjudicated and civil_relief_requires_prior_landholding_determination and revenue_court_has_exclusive_authority_to_determine_those_rights

predicates.civil_suit: A claimant brought a suit in a civil court seeking relief concerning a disputed right or interest.
predicates.agricultural_land_dispute: The disputed property is agricultural land.
predicates.claimant_landholding_rights_unadjudicate: The claimant’s asserted landholding rights have not yet been determined by the court with authority to decide them.
predicates.civil_relief_requires_prior_landholding_: The civil relief sought depends on first establishing that the claimant holds the asserted landholding rights.
predicates.revenue_court_has_exclusive_authority_to: The law assigns exclusive authority to a revenue court to determine the asserted landholding rights.

issues.definition: When a civil suit concerns agricultural land and the requested civil relief depends on landholding rights that remain undecided and are assigned exclusively to a revenue court, the civil court cannot grant that relief before those rights are decreed.
